title: Suffix-copying configurations
statement: Let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words, and let $o$ be a Boolean flag. For every natural number $j$ with $j\leq |w.\mathrm{drop}(|s|)|$, after $j$ steps from the preparation configuration in phase $1$ with candidate and copy tapes both containing $s$, empty suffix tape, input head at the saturated position after $|s|$ cells, and work-head positions $|s|$ and $0$, the candidate and copy tapes remain unchanged, the suffix tape contains the first $j$ symbols of the suffix of $w$ after $s$, and the input and suffix-tape heads are at the saturated position after $|s|+j$ cells and at position $j$, respectively. The phase and flag remain $1$ and $o$.
replaced:
For every $j$ at most the length of the native suffix after position
$\abs{s}$, $j$ steps of the preparation machine in its suffix phase copy the
first $j$ bits of that suffix onto the third tape and advance the native
head accordingly; the other tapes are unchanged.
